phrase.en: Write the document clearly. Everyone should understand it.
phrase.ru: Пишите документ понятно. Каждый должен его понять.
phrase.es: Escribe el documento con claridad. Todos deberían entenderlo.

text.ru: Write — wrote — written. Наречие clearly описывает глагол: write clearly, а не write clear. Everyone — единственное число: everyone understands.
text.en: Write – wrote – written. Use the adverb: write clearly, not write clear. Everyone is singular: everyone understands.
text.es: write – wrote – written. clearly con el verbo. Everyone = singular.

examples.en: She wrote the guide last week.
examples.ru: Она написала руководство на прошлой неделе.
